---
title: "4 PCR Clean-up"
---

**Approximate time:** 1.5 hours  
**WAMBAnet-derived step; pooling scheme must be confirmed for SHARK-Seq.**

## Equipment

- Hula mixer / gentle rotator
- Vortex mixer and microfuge
- Magnetic stand suitable for 1.5 mL tubes
- Multichannel pipette where applicable
- 1000, 200, 20 and 2.5 µL pipettes

## Reagents

- CleanPCR® magnetic beads
- Freshly prepared 75% ethanol
- Nuclease-free water

::: {.callout-warning}
## Pooling decision required
The original WAMBAnet workflow pooled indexed PCRs. The supplied SHARK-Seq material does **not** yet specify whether the new reference/eDNA PCRs already carry sample-specific indexes. Do not pool samples simply because the old protocol did. Record the workshop decision first.
:::

## Bead clean-up

The WAMBAnet protocol used **1.8× CleanPCR bead volume** (e.g. 36 µL beads for 20 µL PCR mix).

| PCR volume | CleanPCR at 1.8× |
|---:|---:|
| 10 µL | 18 µL |
| 20 µL | 36 µL |
| 40 µL | 72 µL |
| 50 µL | 90 µL |

- [ ] Vortex/resuspend CleanPCR beads before use.
- [ ] Add the selected 1.8× bead volume to the PCR product.
- [ ] Mix and incubate on a gentle rotator for 5 min; briefly spin down.
- [ ] Place on magnet until the supernatant clears.
- [ ] Remove supernatant without disturbing beads.
- [ ] Wash with 75% ethanol without resuspending the pellet.
- [ ] Remove ethanol and repeat for a second wash.
- [ ] Remove residual ethanol carefully.
- [ ] Air dry sufficiently to remove ethanol, but avoid excessive over-drying.
- [ ] Remove from magnet and elute in the workshop-defined volume of nuclease-free water.
- [ ] Mix, incubate briefly, return to magnet and transfer the clear eluate to a clean tube.
